title: Staggered circuit reset and eviction softening to reduce regional failover storms
author: Maya Liu
description: Motivation: following a recent incident where simultaneous circuit resets in multiple AZs caused an amplified eviction cascade and a regional failover storm, this change introduces a staggered circuit-reset protocol and 'eviction softening' window to smooth fallback transitions. Goals: 1) avoid synchronized circuit resets across instances and regions; 2) temporarily relax eviction aggressiveness during initial recovery to prevent downstream capacity thrashing; 3) provide observability hooks and bypass flags for on-call. High-level approach: add randomized, tunable delay windows to circuit reset logic (default jitter 10-45s per node) and implement a short-lived eviction softening mode that reduces priority eviction rates and increases token-budget thresholds for in-flight requests for 30s after a region signals recovery. Safety: default parameters are conservative; feature controlled by launch flag runtime.feature.staggeredCircuitReset and can be disabled per-region via config. Rollout plan: canary deploy to eu-west-1 (10% of nodes) for 2 hours, monitor SLO/burst evictions, then increment to 50% and full rollout. Includes hotfix path to force immediate reset for critical infra. Backwards compatibility: no API change; only affects runtime behavior. Checklist: [x] unit tests for jitter logic [x] integration test for softening window [x] observability events added [x] runbook updated [x] canary plan defined. Related work: ENG-5582, ENG-5690, incident INT-2026-02-12. Description of changes and notes on behavior are in PR comments and runbook.

release_notes: Introduce staggered circuit reset with jittered delays and a short eviction softening window to reduce synchronized failover storms. Configurable per-region and per-pool. Enabled behind feature flag. Non-breaking runtime change.
notes_for_oncall: Feature flag: runtime.feature.staggeredCircuitReset. Emergency bypass: /admin/reset?force=true will perform hard reset ignoring jitter. Observability: new metrics circuit_reset.jitter_applied and eviction.softening.active; dashboards updated in ops/runbooks. If you see degraded capacity after rollout, disable feature flag for region and trigger queued hard resets as documented in runbook.
